description:
Make registry-first item queries take their TOML sources from the captured image, so `jit item` reads no declaration file outside its capture.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs` ~255: for a registry-first kind, the item query reads `gates.toml`, `rules.toml` or `invariants.toml` through `storage.read_repo_file` after capturing declarations, so a concurrent replacement makes the query consume bytes outside its image.
- Story `d675102c` sol re-checkpoint review (commit `cea13616e`), finding 1. Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08): read the sources from the captured image's bytes and delete the `read_repo_file` path rather than keeping both.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-10 (read paths take declarations from a captured image).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Registry-first item queries (`jit item show`, `search`, `list`) obtain each kind's TOML source from the captured image the query reads; the `read_repo_file` path in `commands/item.rs` is removed.
- [hard] REQ-02: One test owns "item queries read registry-first sources from the captured image", observing that a source replaced after capture does not reach the query's result.
- [hard] REQ-03: Item query output is unchanged for an unchanged repository.


- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08): local reworks of this task's parse behaviour stop after two code-review failures on parse-once findings; the reparse closes through `86a183c2`'s shared `DeclarationMemo` (dependency added). The captured-bytes behaviour stays landed; code-review reruns after `86a183c2` lands.


- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): stated deviation from REQ-03, following the `a869900b` non-regular-file ruling. Registry-first item sources take the canonical `RepositoryImage::file_bytes` semantics: capture never follows symlinks, consistent with the no-follow capability layer, and a non-regular occupant (directory) reads as absent. A `policies.toml` symlink or directory occupant therefore changes query output by design; this does not violate REQ-03. No local `item.rs` fix: whether a non-regular occupant should read as absent is decided at the `file_bytes` source for every consumer (v1.1 follow-up `74657d61`).
title: Registry-first item queries read their sources from the captured image
